svg.font-family: 'Source Code Pro', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace
svg.aria-label: Launch Control XL button layout: a two-by-eight button grid whose column 8 holds the 8A and 8B modifiers, then the four-button function column SHIFT, MUTE, SOLO and REC ARM, then a photograph of that column on the rig, its buttons lit pink and labelled Device, Mute, Solo and Record Arm
svg.text: Launch Control XL — the six modifiers
Buttons are named by column and row: 1A is the top of column 1.
Column 8 is no sequencer: its buttons are 8A and 8B.
